services.name: web-app
services.purpose: Runs the containerized web application serving HTTP requests

services.name: alb
services.purpose: Distributes incoming traffic across web app tasks and terminates HTTPS

dependencies.description: Routes incoming HTTP/HTTPS requests to the web application containers

ingress: HTTP 80 from internet to alb (redirect to 443)
network.notes: ALB is placed in public subnets and forwards traffic to web-app tasks running in private subnets. No VPN or additional network segmentation specified.

ambiguities.detail: The description does not specify how the web app should be hosted (EC2, ECS, Lambda, etc.)
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed ECS Fargate for a simple, serverless container-based deployment

ambiguities.detail: No mention of data persistence or database needs
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed a relational database (RDS PostgreSQL) is needed for typical web app data storage

ambiguities.detail: No mention of how traffic reaches the app or if HTTPS is required
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed an Application Load Balancer with HTTPS termination in front of the web app

ambiguities.detail: No VPC, subnet, or region details were specified
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed a standard VPC with public subnets for the load balancer and private subnets for application and database tiers
Assumed us-east-1 as the default region

ambiguities.detail: No information on expected traffic, instance size, or scaling policy
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed default minimal Fargate task size (0.25 vCPU/0.5GB) with no auto-scaling configured beyond defaults

ambiguities.detail: No programming language, framework, or runtime was specified for the web app
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed a generic containerized application deployed via a Dockerfile, runtime unspecified

ambiguities.detail: No mention of monitoring, logging, or deployment automation requirements
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed no monitoring or CI/CD pipeline is required at this stage; only core infrastructure and container build files are included
